title: MOXIE Theater

services.name: Yoga Play
services.desc: Yoga apparel giant Jojomon is at the top of its game when a terrible scandal sends them into freefall. Newly hired CEO Joan stakes everything on a wild plan to recover their earnings and their reputation. YOGA PLAY is a comedy about enlightenment in a world determined to sell it. When you donate to MOXIE, you support our mission to create more diverse and honest images of women+ for our culture. Your gift launches careers and fosters gender equality. Or consider helping us support women’s theatre by making a tax-deductible donation
